title: 6 hurt after truck crashes into warehouse in Benguet town

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY – Six people were injured after a 10-wheeler Isuzu wing van truck crashed into a warehouse inside the Philippine Rabbit Compound along Marcos Highway in Tuba, Benguet, on Monday night. The truck suffered a brake malfunction, causing the driver to lose control and run towards the structure. The 45-year-old driver, a resident of the town of Sto. Tomas in Batangas, and his helper were among those injured. The police did not identify the other injured individuals.
